newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-SUDDEN DEATH FOR PSV IN DUTCH CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SUDDEN DEATH FOR PSV IN DUTCH CUP.

text.p: Midfielder Roberto Verhagen fired a sudden-death "golden goal" as AZ Alkmaar snatched an upset victory over PSV Eindhoven in the Dutch Cup on Wednesday.
Alkmaar won the third-round match 3-2 in extra time after the sides were level 2-2 at the end of 90 minutes.
Belgium striker Luc Nilis gave league leaders PSV the lead twice, in the sixth minute from a free kick and in the 53rd from the penalty spot.
However, Michael Buskermolen equalised twice, in the seventh and 61st minutes.
After 13 minutes of extra time, a mistake by PSV skipper Arthur Numan gave former Eindhoven player Verhagen room to hit the winner.
PSV are the second top side to make an early exit in the Dutch Cup following Ajax's elimination in the second round.
